name: TriviaQA
description: A large-scale reading comprehension dataset containing trivia questions authored by trivia enthusiasts, paired with evidence documents and answer annotations.
citation: Joshi, M., Choi, E., Weld, D. S., & Zettlemoyer, L. (2017). TriviaQA: A Large Scale Distantly Supervised Challenge Dataset for Reading Comprehension. Proceedings of the 55th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics, 1601–1611. https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/P17-1147

license.notes: The upstream project does not specify a standard SPDX license for the dataset. Evidence documents originate from external sources and may have separate rights and terms; review upstream terms and underlying content rights before use or redistribution.
